name: German Apple Pancakes
desc: Pannekoeken: cinnamon-sugar apple wedges baked under a puffy custard batter in a 9x13 pan.

source.title: Gamma's Pannekoeken - Baked Apple Pancake
source.evidence: Same 9x13 baked apple pancake: 4 eggs whisked with flour, milk and salt, butter melted in the pan, apples, and cinnamon sugar, baked until puffed and golden.

ingredients.raw: 3 medium Gala apples, cored and cut into 1/2-inch wedges

steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, flour, and salt until smooth.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon and toss with the apple wedges.
Put the butter in a 9x13 inch baking dish and set it in the oven until melted, about 5 minutes. Tilt the dish to coat the bottom and sides.
Spread the apples in the dish and pour the batter over them.
Bake until puffed, golden brown, and set in the center, 30 to 35 minutes. Serve right away; it deflates as it cools.
tips: Most published versions bake hotter, 400 to 425°F, for a taller puff; this one runs cooler and longer, which cooks the apple wedges through.

references.title: Gamma's Pannekoeken - Baked Apple Pancake
